problem: What capabilities could make HowlCreate fundamentally better at machine-assisted creativity than conventional brainstorming tools?

assumptions.statement: The problem must be resolved by human coordinators synchronously.

Autonomous micro-agents negotiate contracts without human mediation.
assumptions.vulnerability: Breaks under high latency and timezone fragmentation.

assumptions.statement: Centralized authority is required to verify quality of work.
inversions: Quality is verified by automated mathematical proofs and test suites.
Reputation is bonded in bilateral escrow rather than platform-policed.
assumptions.vulnerability: Creates an administrative bottleneck and platform extraction rent.

reframings.reframed_question: How could an untrusted anonymous entity extract bounties maliciously?
How can valuable engineering happen with intermittent power and zero cloud credits?
reframings.core_focus: Offline-first computation and tiny compute footprints.
